## Notes

11 bit studios; Windows, OS X, Linux 2014-11-14, later mobile and consoles; daytime shelter crafting, trading, and care, night scavenging; hunger, health, and mood until a randomized ceasefire; one or two traits per survivor; moral choices affect endings; radio reports; inspired by the Siege of Sarajevo.
